name: Unidentified mercury-based species
description: A sentient species of beings mostly made of mercury and capable of shapeshifting was native to the Outer Rim planet Sevetta, which was mercury-rich and had a toxic atmosphere. The rogue clone trooper Hunter was aware of the species, and during or after 18 BBY, while on the mercury-rich planet Tryth, he told fellow clone Omega about them, which amazed her.
